notes.headline: The IST semifinals are set
notes.dek: Zach won Group A to join Jakobi, Zhang and Yash in the semis. Guangdong and Shanghai are the last unbeaten teams, and K-Ville had a perfect all-play week.
notes.byline: Written from Fantrax league data for Week 5 (Nov 16–22).

storylines.title: IST: four left
storylines.body: Zach (Guangdong) beat Tom 6–3 to win Group A. This week's semifinals happen to be real matchups too: Zach vs. Jakobi (Competing God), line Guangdong −4.5, and Yash (LeBrown James) vs. Zhang (Shanghai), line LeBrown −1. The final is Week 7, $60 to the winner.

storylines.title: K-Ville runs the table
storylines.body: K-Ville would have beaten all 11 teams, leading the league in threes (104) and FT% (.898), and beat eweiss35 6–3. Jokic (115 points, 48 rebounds, 38 assists) and Jamal Murray (108 points) made the Rec Starting 5.

storylines.title: Two unbeatens left
storylines.body: Shanghai beat LeBrown James 6–3 to move to 5–0, joining Guangdong (5–0). Sam Presti beat Team OD 6–2–1 with league highs in points (819), rebounds (316) and assists (210), and another league-high 130 turnovers.

storylines.title: Blocktopus survives
storylines.body: Blocktopus beat West Palm Salon 5–4 with a league-best .512 FG%. Jaden McDaniels was the week's top player (111 points on 63% shooting) and joined Wembanyama (107 points, 47 rebounds) in the Pro-Am Starting 5.

storylines.title: Against the spread
storylines.body: Favorites went 1–4 with a push against the line (K-Ville the only one to cover) and have covered 6 of 23 decided lines this season. LaMelo Ball (West Palm Salon) takes the Brown Shirt at 26 of 77; AJ Dybantsa topped the rookies with 80 points and 35 rebounds.

matchups.070oazg4mqqv88in_rufupenmmqqv88in: IST semifinal. Line: Guangdong −4.5. Projects 7–2 Guangdong; Competing God's edges are rebounds and turnovers.
matchups.ygisq4rlmqqv88in_cipchrpimqqv88in: IST semifinal and a Rec heavyweight fight. Line: LeBrown −1. Projects 5–4 LeBrown (FG%, FT%, points, assists, blocks) over Shanghai (threes, rebounds, steals, turnovers).

matchups.saydaqzgmqqv88in_xoe774vlmqqv88in: Line: K-Ville −5.5. Projects 8–1 K-Ville; West Palm Salon's edge is turnovers.
matchups.mizl2op8mqqv88im_auysoygrmqqv88in: Line: Team OD −3. Projects 7–2 Team OD; Bankruptcy's edges are FT% and steals.

bruno.auysoygrmqqv88in: Second, a hair behind Presti. Cooper Flagg and Darryn Peterson are both 23 in the title season, and Anthony Edwards (29) is still in his prime. Tenth today, but climbing.
bruno.d91prsm4mqqv88in: Back to No. 1. Dylan Harper and Caleb Wilson are both 24 in the title season, with Haliburton (30) and a hot Cedric Coward and Jeremiah Fears around them. Their line rises every year.
bruno.070oazg4mqqv88in: Third, and second today. Doncic is 31 in the title season, with Holmgren (28) and Scottie Barnes (29) still in their primes, so the decline is gentle.
bruno.b33iacngmqqv88in: Fourth, and third today. Wembanyama and Duren are both 26 in the title season, with Kessler (29) behind them. No picks, but the line holds steady through 2031.
bruno.ygisq4rlmqqv88in: Fifth on both lists. Maxey (30) and Donovan Clingan (26) are the 2030–31 core, but Tatum is 32 by then, so the line stays flat.
bruno.mizl2op8mqqv88im: Down to seventh. Shai is 32 and Bam Adebayo 33 in the title season, with Kon Knueppel (25) as the young piece. Fourth today, so the window is now.
bruno.saydaqzgmqqv88in: Up to sixth. AJ Dybantsa (23) and VJ Edgecombe (25) lead a roster whose strength rises every season, with eight picks still to come.
bruno.xoe774vlmqqv88in: Eighth. Second-best roster today, but Jokic is 35 and Murray 33 in the title season, and their strength falls every year.
bruno.rufupenmmqqv88in: Ninth. Cameron Boozer (23) and Ausar Thompson (27) give them a young base, but the veterans around them age out.
bruno.ctvglb6gmqqv88in: Tenth. Kevin Porter (30), Austin Reaves (32) and Giannis (35) are past their peaks by 2030–31, and they hold no picks.
bruno.cipchrpimqqv88in: Eleventh. Dyson Daniels and Amen Thompson (both 27) are a good base, but the line drifts down as the veterans age.
bruno.n3z2eshxmqqv88in: Twelfth, but ten picks are the most in the league. Nate Ament (23) is the start; expect a big climb once those picks become players.
